name: PNTHLEAD program from The Pink Panther Theme

pitchSettlesAfterUpdates.detail: probe-interface-v1: the first update at full pitch is 1 after the row for every probe pitch and after a rest (update 0 is the start frame), so a note of 2 updates sounds at its pitch

character.summary: Embedded as PNTHLEAD for the lead part; envelope A2 D6 S7 R4.

waveforms.detail: probe-interface-v1: waveform bits of the gated, non-TEST updates of the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates: saw x137

body.detail: probe-interface-v1: classified from the 137 gated body updates of the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates: distinct pulse widths 1, distinct cutoffs 13, noise share 0.0

release.detail: envelope release nibble 4 = 114 ms full-scale (datasheet rate)

level.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 69 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; AC RMS dBFS over the first 250 ms and over 1.0-1.9 s of the note

brightness.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 69 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; spectral centroid divided by the fundamental over 0-60 ms and 50-550 ms (pure triangle about 1.0)

motion.detail: probe-interface-v1: frequency deviates up to 0.52 % from the settled pitch over the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates, 29 sign flips, first visible 18 updates after the row
probe-interface-v1: 13 distinct filter cutoffs in [736, 832] over the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates, first visible 2 updates after the row

provenance.rights: MIT (original project instrument definition, no upstream preset bytes copied; the arrangement it is embedded in carries separate terms)
